# Hero Image Spec — Pīkau (Freight & Customs)

**Purpose:** Static visual for V3 (proof-led) cold email + LinkedIn share card aimed at licensed customs brokers. Recipient sees a customs entry bundle that looks like it was hand-prepared by a broker, NOT generated by AI. The "agent does not lodge" boundary is visible.

**Generated by:** Kate (Vessel Studio) OR delegated to a designer
**Saved to:** `/public/assets/hero/pikau-evidence.png` in the repo, then deployed
**Final URL:** `https://www.assembl.co.nz/assets/hero/pikau-evidence.png`

---

## Composition

- **Aspect ratio:** 16:9 (1600 × 900 px, retina 3200 × 1800 px)
- **Subject:** Flat-design rendering of an open customs entry bundle on warm cream paper. Two pages — left page cover, right page tariff classification.
- **Background:** Warm paper `#FAF7F2`.
- **Pack rendering:** Flat illustration. Brand-canon typography + palette only.
- **Vessel cameo:** Top-right corner — Evidence Vessel motif at 15% of canvas height.

---

## Page content (visible in the mock-pack)

**Left page (cover):**
- Top eyebrow: `assembl · evidence pack` (IBM Plex Mono uppercase, taupe)
- H1: `Customs Entry Bundle — Shipment AIR-2026-0287` (Cormorant Garamond, weight 400, pounamu)
- Sub-line: `Hydraulic press parts · Ningbo → Auckland · CIF NZ$73,118`
- Date: `17 March 2026`
- Decision pill: `⚠ APPROVAL-REQUIRED · for licensed broker review` (gold border, cream fill, ink text)

**Right page (tariff classification — the punchline):**
- H2: `Tariff classification` (Cormorant Garamond, weight 300)
- Sub: `Three candidates returned — agent never gives one answer`
- Row 1: `HS 8462.99.00 — Other forging/die-stamping machines · 5% · 🟢 RECOMMENDED`
- Row 2: `HS 8462.10.00 — Forging or die-stamping presses · 5%`
- Row 3: `HS 8479.89.00 — Mechanical appliances; other · Free · ❌ rejected (specific heading prevails)`
- Footer: `TSW lodgement: ⛔ agent does not lodge · licensed broker only`

The three-candidate display is the visual STORY. assembl never gives brokers a single answer for a tariff lookup. The broker-not-agent boundary on TSW is shown.

---

## Text overlay (embedded in image)

- **Top-left:** small Cormorant italic caption: `Pīkau · Shipment AIR-2026-0287 · drafted by agent, lodged by Kim Coveny, NZCB · 17 March 2026`
- **Bottom-centre:** H1 statement: `Mahi that earns its proof.` (Cormorant Garamond, weight 300)
- **No CTA in the image itself.**

## Vessel Studio prompt

```
A flat-design editorial composition. 16:9 aspect ratio. Warm cream
paper background (#FAF7F2). Subject: an open two-page PDF document at
slight perspective — left page is a customs-entry bundle cover for a
shipment from China to Auckland, right page shows three tariff
classifications with one highlighted as RECOMMENDED. Cream ceramic
Evidence Vessel motif top-right corner. Cormorant Garamond headings,
IBM Plex Mono small labels with retrieval timestamps, Inter body. No
photography, no shipping-container imagery, no AI shimmer. Style:
Aesop catalogue meets editorial design. Subtle drop-shadows under
document pages. A small "agent does not lodge — broker only" footer
label visible. The phrase "Mahi that earns its proof." sits in
Cormorant weight 300 at the bottom centre.
```

---

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Aspect 16:9 (1600×900 minimum, retina preferred)
- [ ] Cream `#FAF7F2` background dominant ≥80%
- [ ] Pounamu `#2B6B57` only on document accents
- [ ] Gold border on the APPROVAL-REQUIRED pill (kete-gold `#D9BC7A`)
- [ ] Three HS classifications visually distinct (so it's obvious the agent returned 3, not 1)
- [ ] "Agent does not lodge" footer label readable at LinkedIn thumbnail size
- [ ] No shipping-container photography — too literal, undermines the editorial quietness
- [ ] No AI shimmer / no glow effects
- [ ] Lowercase `assembl` if wordmark visible

---

**Time to generate (Vessel Studio + 1-2 retakes): ~5 minutes of Kate's time.**
